protocol.scope: OpenAnt OnChain A2MCP and the shared A2A envelope

invariants.statement: A2MCP transfers buyer to seller and A2A transfers only to its escrow contract; neither OpenAnt nor 0xkey is a customer funds pool.
OpenAnt owns commercial state and 0xkey owns funding authorization and settlement state; either side stores only signed references to the other side's facts.
A service definition, price, payout, endpoint, key, or rule change creates a new component version, SKU root, and seller-signed ListingMandate.
Unknown signature, policy, budget, facilitator, or proof state creates no new risk exposure and is never treated as success.
A final settlement is never rolled back; a commercial refund is a new seller-authorized transaction.
PaymentIntent, funding proofs, events, logs, and traces contain identifiers, hashes, amounts, issuer data, and state only; raw request, response, prompt, arguments, and artifact bytes are forbidden.
Hosted settlement is allowed only after complete output bytes have passed schema, media type, size, and hash checks and are durably staged in encrypted content escrow.
No single issuer claims end-to-end success; payment proves payment, while hosted delivery proof or direct buyer acceptance proves technical fulfillment.

formats.uint256-decimal: ASCII 0 or a non-zero digit followed by ASCII digits, no leading zero, numeric value at most 2^256-1
formats.rfc3339-utc-whole-seconds: exact YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ that round-trips to the same proleptic Gregorian UTC instant; impossible calendar dates and leap seconds are invalid

crossObjectBindings.resolve: ResolvedServiceDefinitionVersion is fetched by ServiceSKUVersion.serviceDefinitionVersionDigest and its canonical digest MUST be recomputed
ResolvedOfferVersion is fetched by ServiceSKUVersion.offerVersionDigest and its canonical digest MUST be recomputed
ResolvedEndpointDescriptorVersion is fetched by ServiceSKUVersion.endpointDescriptorVersionDigest and its canonical digest MUST be recomputed
ResolvedServiceSKUVersion is selected by ListingMandate.skuVersionDigest; its canonical root digest MUST be recomputed before child resolution
ServiceSKUVersion resolves the canonically recomputed EndpointDescriptorVersion and OfferVersion child digests before any challenge is issued
crossObjectBindings.rule: Phase 0 DIRECT requires DIRECT_BUYER_ACCEPTED plus DIRECT custody; HOSTED requires HOSTED_RECOVERABLE plus a Hosted custody class. NONE and SELLER_ASSERTED remain vocabulary values but are not realizable SKU minimums in Phase 0
A WalletAuthorizationProof represents an EIP-3009 authorization whose validBefore boundary is exclusive

The observation instant is read internally from the live verifier clock and cannot be supplied or backdated by the caller; historical verification remains unsupported until a verifiable TSA or transparency-log profile is registered
All comparisons are inclusive and all objects are correlated by the same Invocation and SKU root

crossObjectBindings.resolve: Every evidence object MUST first pass concrete type, digest, Invocation, SKU, PaymentIntent, signer-role, and content-lineage bindings; mode comes from the resolved EndpointDescriptorVersion
crossObjectBindings.rule: Settlement evidence timestamped before the applicable complete-output evidence is invalid under INV-OUTPUT-BEFORE-SETTLE

crossObjectBindings.condition: Invocation.mode == HOSTED and (Invocation.state in [DELIVERED, ACKED] or (Invocation.state == RECOVERY_WINDOW_EXPIRED and Invocation.deliveryReceiptDigest is present))
crossObjectBindings.resolve: ResolvedDeliveryReceipt is selected by Invocation.deliveryReceiptDigest and MUST already match claims digest, Invocation, and SKU

ResolvedTransferWithAuthorizationTypedData is the exact Phase 0 Base USDC EIP-3009 object derived from the WalletAuthorizationProof and resolved PaymentIntent; no caller-supplied digest or TypedData field is authoritative

crossObjectBindings.right: digest(RECEIPT_CLAIMS, WalletAuthorizationProof excluding claimsDigest and signature)
crossObjectBindings.rule: The EIP-3009 signature does not directly sign receipt claims; claimsDigest is independently recomputed from the complete receipt claims, including paymentAuthorizationDigest

crossObjectBindings.resolve: ResolvedInvocation is selected by DeliveryAcknowledgement.invocationId
ResolvedDeliveryReceipt is required and selected by DeliveryAcknowledgement.deliveryReceiptDigest

crossObjectBindings.rule: ResolvedDeliveryReceipt MUST carry responseDigest and MUST NOT carry artifactManifestDigest

crossObjectBindings.resolve: ResolvedDeliveryReceipt and ResolvedArtifactManifest are both required; ResolvedDeliveryReceipt MUST NOT carry responseDigest
ResolvedInvocation is selected by AcceptanceReceipt.invocationId
ResolvedExecutionReceipt and ResolvedAcceptanceReceipt are selected by Invocation.executionReceiptDigest and Invocation.acceptanceReceiptDigest after both concrete receipt bindings pass
crossObjectBindings.rule: Both receipts MUST select the same single content kind; the Buyer cannot accept content different from the Seller's signed complete output

crossObjectBindings.resolve: ResolvedProof is the independently fetched object selected by ProofReference.objectDigest

crossObjectBindings.right: ResolvedProof.signature.issuer or ResolvedProof.attestation.issuer as selected by objectType
ResolvedProof.signature.keyId or ResolvedProof.attestation.keyId as selected by objectType
ResolvedProof.issuedAt; ListingMandate uses validFrom; external credentials use their canonical issuance time

crossObjectBindings.condition: ProofBundle contains any MandateAuthorizationProof, WalletAuthorizationProof, SettlementReceipt, FundingUnknownObservation, or CommerceReceipt with a resolved SettlementReceipt
rules: every resolved funding proof paymentIntentId == ResolvedPaymentIntent.paymentIntentId
every resolved funding proof paymentIntentFingerprintDigest == ResolvedPaymentIntent.fingerprintDigest

MandateAuthorizationProof.paymentAuthorizationDigest, WalletAuthorizationProof.paymentAuthorizationDigest, SettlementReceipt.paymentAuthorizationDigest, and FundingUnknownObservation.authorizationDigest when present all equal ResolvedPaymentIntent.authorizationDigest
a CommerceReceipt contributes its independently resolved SettlementReceipt to the same checks
crossObjectBindings.resolve: ResolvedInvocation is selected by ProofBundle.invocationId; ResolvedPaymentIntent is selected only by ResolvedInvocation.paymentIntentRef; every proof object has already passed reference/type/digest/Invocation/SKU validation
crossObjectBindings.rule: Same Invocation and SKU are insufficient: authorization A cannot be composed with settlement B
Only APPROVED is an authorization proof and can satisfy MANDATE_PROTECTED assurance
The wallet proof signer is the buyer actor authorized by the PaymentIntent, not an arbitrary self-signed actor
An anonymous wallet actor is self-certifying and cannot claim another OpenAnt or Agent identity
The recovered EIP-712 signer MUST be the PaymentIntent payerAddress; a buyer actor self-signature over another payer is insufficient

crossObjectBindings.right: domain={name:USD Coin,version:2,chainId:8453,verifyingContract:Base USDC}; primaryType=TransferWithAuthorization; types=[from address,to address,value uint256,validAfter uint256,validBefore uint256,nonce bytes32]; message={from:lowercase(WalletAuthorizationProof.payerAddress),to:lowercase(WalletAuthorizationProof.payeeAddress),value:WalletAuthorizationProof.amountAtomic,validAfter:0,validBefore:unix_seconds(WalletAuthorizationProof.expiresAt),nonce:0x || raw32(WalletAuthorizationProof.paymentIntentFingerprintDigest)}
crossObjectBindings.rule: No extra domain, type, message, or top-level field is accepted. The profile-selected fingerprint covers the common challenge, SKU, buyer, payer, mode, assurance, and settlement context; MANDATE_PROTECTED additionally covers tenant, treasury, mandate, agent, runtime, and capability context. Using its raw 32 bytes as nonce binds exactly that profile without pretending these are EIP-3009 fields.

crossObjectBindings.right: pair(ProofReference.issuedAt, ResolvedProof.issuedAt or canonical issuance time)
crossObjectBindings.rule: ProofBundle.createdAt MUST be greater than or equal to both correlated issuance instants

crossObjectBindings.resolve: ResolvedOpenAntX402Extension is the independently verified signed object selected by PaymentIntent.challengeDigest

crossObjectBindings.timeRule: RuntimeCapability.issuedAt <= PaymentIntent.createdAt and PaymentIntent.expiresAt <= RuntimeCapability.expiresAt, inclusive

crossObjectBindings.rule: buyerActorRef identifies either the delegated Agent actor for MANDATE_PROTECTED or the wallet actor for WALLET_SIGNED; it is always bound to the Invocation
Only the delegated mandate profile carries agent/runtime/capability fields; the Agent is the Invocation buyer actor

crossObjectBindings.resolve: ResolvedServiceSKUVersion and its three child roots MUST pass all SKU resolution bindings

crossObjectBindings.rule: Both receipts MUST select the same single content kind; neither receipt may switch response/artifact domains

crossObjectBindings.right: MandateAuthorizationProof when requested authorization is MANDATE_PROTECTED, WalletAuthorizationProof when WALLET_SIGNED; digest, invocationId, serviceSkuVersionDigest, and paymentIntentId MUST match
OutputStagingReceipt claimsDigest with equal invocationId and serviceSkuVersionDigest
ExecutionReceipt claimsDigest with equal invocationId and serviceSkuVersionDigest
SettlementReceipt claimsDigest with equal invocationId, serviceSkuVersionDigest, and paymentIntentId
DeliveryReceipt claimsDigest with equal invocationId and serviceSkuVersionDigest
FundingUnknownObservation claimsDigest with equal invocationId, serviceSkuVersionDigest, paymentIntentId, and reconciliationDeadline
digest(DELIVERY_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT, ResolvedDeliveryAcknowledgement) with equal invocationId and buyerActorRef
AcceptanceReceipt claimsDigest with equal invocationId, serviceSkuVersionDigest, and buyerActorRef
SettlementReceipt claimsDigest with equal invocationId, serviceSkuVersionDigest, and paymentIntentId
FundingUnknownObservation claimsDigest with equal invocationId, serviceSkuVersionDigest, paymentIntentId, observedState, unknownBoundary, and reconciliationDeadline

crossObjectBindings.resolve: OutputStagingReceipt.serviceSkuVersionDigest selects ResolvedServiceSKUVersion; its endpointDescriptorVersionDigest selects ResolvedEndpointDescriptorVersion

crossObjectBindings.rule: VerifierPolicy is OpenAnt/verifier-local configuration and cannot be authored by the Seller, Listing, SKU, or EndpointDescriptor

crossObjectBindings.resolve: ResolvedSettlementReceipt is selected by CommerceReceipt.settlementReceiptDigest and MUST have objectType SettlementReceipt with equal invocationId and serviceSkuVersionDigest
CommerceReceipt.serviceSkuVersionDigest resolves the SKU and its EndpointDescriptorVersion
ExecutionReceipt.serviceSkuVersionDigest selects ResolvedServiceSKUVersion; its endpointDescriptorVersionDigest selects ResolvedEndpointDescriptorVersion
DeliveryReceipt.serviceSkuVersionDigest selects ResolvedServiceSKUVersion; its endpointDescriptorVersionDigest selects ResolvedEndpointDescriptorVersion

crossObjectBindings.rule: A Seller-provided endpoint key cannot independently assert Hosted delivery or custody

crossObjectBindings.right: only stagingIssuerKeys and deliveryIssuerKeys MAY overlap
rules: executionIssuerKeys is disjoint from stagingIssuerKeys, deliveryIssuerKeys, and commerceIssuerKeys
commerceIssuerKeys is disjoint from stagingIssuerKeys and deliveryIssuerKeys
stagingIssuerKeys and deliveryIssuerKeys MAY overlap for one Hosted gateway

crossObjectBindings.resolve: Both objects are resolved from the same ProofBundle and serviceSkuVersionDigest scope

crossObjectBindings.rule: VERIFIED_SELLER assurance is evaluated at ProofBundle.createdAt; both interval endpoints are inclusive
VerifierPolicy is local trusted configuration and MUST NOT be supplied by the Seller or ProofBundle
PaymentRequiredOutcome has no unsigned duplicate invocationId field

crossObjectBindings.resolve: ResolvedListingMandate is selected by PaymentRequiredOutcome.paymentRequired.extensions.openant.listingMandateDigest
ResolvedServiceSKUVersion and all three immutable child versions MUST pass BIND-SKU-*-RESOLUTION before accepting the challenge

crossObjectBindings.rule: The standard x402 acceptance is separately bound to the signed extension; changing both copies still fails against ResolvedOfferVersion

crossObjectBindings.resolve: ResolvedInvocation is independently loaded by the signed extension invocationId; all six signed scope fields MUST match before PaymentIntent creation

digestProfiles.output: the literal prefix sha256: followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters
digestProfiles.structuredCanonicalization: RFC 8785 JCS over the exact JSON projection named by the profile

PAYMENT_INTENT_FINGERPRINT.includeOnly: idempotency.paymentIntentFingerprintCommonFields plus the exact idempotency.paymentIntentFingerprintConditionalFields entry selected by requestedAssurance.authorization; every selected path is required and every unselected profile path is forbidden

PAYMENT_AUTHORIZATION.input: the exact Phase 0 x402 v2 exact EIP-3009 TransferWithAuthorization TypedData: fixed Base USDC domain, closed six-field type, and message derived from payer, payee, amountAtomic, expiresAt, and PaymentIntent fingerprint nonce
PAYMENT_AUTHORIZATION.inputSchema: closed algorithmic profile specified by BIND-WALLET-PROOF-X402-EIP3009

REQUEST_BYTES.input: exact decoded HTTP request body octets accepted for this Invocation; zero bytes are allowed

RESPONSE_BYTES.input: exact response body octets staged and later delivered without transformation

ARTIFACT_BYTES.input: exact artifact octets staged and later delivered without transformation

TRANSACTION_REFERENCE.input: object {network, transactionHash} with transactionHash encoded as a lowercase 0x-prefixed chain-native value

referenceFields.signedObjectDigest: the structured profile selected by the enclosing signed object

pathBindings.selector: enclosing objectType (WalletAuthorizationProof is schema-fixed to EIP712)

digest.canonicalization: recursive UTF-16 code-unit key sort; JSON primitives; arrays preserve order
digest.framing: utf8(path + LF + canonical-json + LF) in listed order
